intro: Technology leads the sectors affected by ai-security coverage across 72 articles published between 2026-04-12 and 2026-09-15, alongside government, cybersecurity, critical infrastructure, and financial services. The reporting spans Global, United states, China, North america, and Europe. Claude Mythos, Midnight Blizzard, and OpenClaw feature among the top threat actors, while tracked vulnerabilities include CVE-2026-5760 (CVSS 9.8), CVE-2026-5752 (CVSS 9.3), CVE-2026-44339 (CVSS 8.6), CVE-2026-44567 (CVSS 7.7), and CVE-2026-45303 (CVSS 7.7). The severity mix comprises 33 high, 9 critical, 14 informational, and 6 medium items.
